expression:
<!-- Write freely. Ordinary language is fine. This is what enters the field verbatim. -->

<!--
What happens next (the generative sequence, FIELD.md / doc Q7 §8):
1. reflection — a bounded operator restates your expression and lists what the restatement omitted
2. you confirm / modify / reject the interpretation (it stays "unconfirmed" until you do)
3. differentiation, relational mapping, tension detection
4. a candidate change (PR) proposes entry into the accepted field
5. someone independent of the proposer accepts — the field advances F_n → F_(n+1)
Nothing is permanently settled. A later element can reopen anything.
